scenes.location: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Báyakan listens at the door and opens it.
Natalia opens the door for Báyakan.
The DART TRAP monster parts are added to the party stash.
The door is opened to reveal room 5: The Grand Hall of the Temple.
Doopa claims they made a maze.
Nadya questions Doopa about the maze construction.
Natalia casts Rousing Splash on party members.
Changer accepts the rousing splash.
Changer takes a step forward onto the unfinished floor.
Nadya carefully follows Changer and directs his movements.
The party determines the door is not trapped after a check.
Changer opens the door.
The party sees a swarm of blood seekers feasting on corpses and combat begins.
Changer wins initiative for the encounter.

scenes.location: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The party defeats the blood seekers in combat.
Monster parts are added to the group stash.
The party investigates the blood seeker corpses and finds a key, a safe, a bottle of rare sake, and a bejewelled brooch.
The party explores the eastern section containing the hall of Kami and discovers a charred corpse near a booby-trapped statue.
The party opens the safe and finds 45 gold pieces.

scenes.location: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Bayakan notices several hazardous points on the wooden floor where a fall could occur.
The party safely walks across the hallway.
The party enters the hall of messages containing angled sand tables and four arrow-studded corpses.
Nadya and Doopa examine the corpses, confirming they are dead, not recent, and not workers.
The GM noted Changer wanted to save Magnimarian citizens and would await at the door.
Changer stood at the doorway.
Nadya briefly tossed the bodies and stood ready to move on.
The party moved onto room 9.
A plaque named room 9 as the hall of wisdom.
Báyakan Tiktik succeeded VS DC 19 on a perception check.
Chase Darkthorne pointed out the snare and sent an ultrasonic pulse into the webbed area.
A female kobold scout on her spider mount was revealed hiding in the webbing.
Changer expressed that his form was not built for physical confrontation.
Rex arrived as backup sent from the lieutenant.
Steele arrived at the scene wearing armor and a mix of leather and metal.
Kitt introduced himself as being on assignment from the Chaplain Unit.
Rex cautiously walked into the doorway.
Chase Darkthorne pointed out a snare trap across the threshold and a spider mounted kobold lurking above.
Chase Darkthorne reaches for his tool kit, uses magic, and attempts to disarm a snare.
Changer mentions cold storage facilities back at base.
Changer introduces himself as an assistant officer of the Magni Guard.
Changer states saving hostages and apprehending criminals is the top priority.
Changer mentions backup integration based on performance output.
Changer notes standard Magni Guard training for non-lethal blows.
Changer asks Officer Nadya if mentioning the zoo helps the investigation.
Changer comments on zoo occupants requiring direct confrontation.
Alastair Tan states former Sergeant Steele's background in the Magnimar City Watch.
The party walks to the doorway before story progression pauses.
Changer asks to state rank.
Changer raises a nonexistent shield.
Changer warns about a kobold riding a spider and a hidden snare.
Changer notes defusing the snare will trigger a foe attack.
A trap is disabled, and a crossbow bolt is launched from above.
Combat begins.
Alastair Tan notes a low initiative roll.
Steele is startled by the bolt before composing herself.
Bayakan Tiktik wins initiative, disables the snare, and takes 7 damage from a kobold scout.
Changer strides forward, uses telekinetic projectile, and deals 6 damage making Kreski bloodied.
Doopa the kobold says hello.
Changer lands a blow and tells the kobold to surrender to the Magni Guard.
Doopa yells for Kreski to give up.
The GM lists unacted and acted allies for round one.
Alastair Tan outlines an action plan involving movement, snagging strike with a sap, and a second strike.
Alastair Tan rolls a success dealing 4 nonlethal bludgeoning damage.
Alastair Tan's second strike misses.
Ryo Yamakawa uses tangle vine and raises a shield.
Kitt restricts kobold Kreski's movement with a vine and raises a shield.
Steele steps forward with her sap, strikes the spider, grabs the mount, and misses her next strike.
Cannon McMahon heals Bayakan and gives temp hp.
Margle the spider takes 4 damage.
Mangle is applied imposing a speed penalty for 1 round.
The GM questions how the spider is being hit 25 feet up on a wall web.
The GM undoes 4 damage because the spider cannot be hit with a sap.
Kitt raises a shield against the kobold and spider mount.
Kreski panics as mangle becomes unsteady.
Kreski tells Mangle to calm down in draconic.
Kreski and Mangle are positioned 25 feet up the wall.
Rex strides twice to flank Kreski and misses his mace strike.
Rex enters a rage, strides to flank Kreski, misses, and comments on the slippery target.
Chase Darkthorne takes medicine from Nadya, casts magic missile at the spider, and pulls back.
Margle takes 8 damage.
Margle becomes bloodied.
Volf retcons an action to stride and shoot Margle with a crossbow for 3 damage.
Volf pushes past people into the room and shoots at the spider.
Alastair Tan retcons actions to stride, demoralise Kreski, and do nothing.
Steele marches in, shouts a warning to surrender, and draws her longsword.
Margle takes 3 damage.
The kobold screeches back in draconic refusing to be slaves.
Captain Vex Ashburn takes damage from injury echo and plasma caster.
